unit: one delivered job-ad text; multiple evidence rows may be recorded per ad

instructions.absence: Use not_mentioned when the supplied text contains no explicit statement. Do not convert silence into an explicit negative.
instructions.strength: Code wording attached to the clause. A qualification mention without required/preferred/expected wording is unspecified.
instructions.duration_binding: Record duration and object separately. Link them only when syntax or a bounded list makes the link explicit; paragraph co-occurrence is not an explicit binding.
instructions.technology: Python, SQL, and ordinary software names do not by themselves imply AI. Company descriptions and recruiting-process AI are not applicant technology requirements.
instructions.roles: Code a role only when the text states an action relation to the technology. Multiple roles may coexist.
instructions.tasks: Describe stated work content; do not infer automation, replacement, or causal effects.
instructions.relations: Preserve each qualification path. Do not collapse OR paths to a single minimum and do not sum INCLUDING durations.
instructions.evidence: Use zero-based, half-open character offsets into raw_text and copy a short evidence_quote. Record uncertainty_reason for unresolved judgments.

independence.calibration: May be opened and used for codebook calibration. Parser predictions remain hidden from annotators.
independence.sealed_test: Do not inspect texts or predictions until codebook/parser changes are frozen. Convention seal only; no cryptographic access control is claimed.
independence.human_review: Formal labels require human review and adjudication. Model or parser output must never be entered as a human label.

time_interpretation: Text is a delivery snapshot attached to a Records.CREATED cohort. It is not verified historical point-in-time text.
